inputs.xtext_rule_text:
Conjugation returns SysML::Conjugation :
	( 'conjugation' Identification? )?
    'conjugate' 
    ( conjugatedType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
    ( '~' | 'conjugates') 
    ( originalType = [SysML::Type | QualifiedName]
	| ownedRelatedElement += OwnedFeatureChain )
	RelationshipBody
;

notes: re-scoped (ADR-0015): only the kerml grammar reaches this production, so its work now lives in Conjugation@kerml
